title: Solitude in Solar Zenith
poem:
Across the quiet canopy of solar zenith,
Where mainly clear amber atmosphere weaves through silent air,
The horizon holds a pulse of celestial light,
Unbroken by the passage of hours.

Whispering currents at 63.9°F awaken the glass,
A canvas drawn without human hands,
Where light meets shadow in harmonious resonance,
And time lingers before turning the page.

Shadows tilt toward the distant perimeter,
Captured in the quiet pulse of an always-on observer,
Each frame a testament to the breathing earth,
Captured while the world slumbers.
